name: Nogizaka Miki
source:
A childhood friend, who goes to wake up the protagonist, every morning.

Recognizes the protagonist as a friend but it has not reached the level of romantic interest.

Has a cute appearance while being concealed in the school, is still popular. The person herself, is not very interested in the matters of love.

Has a very good personality. Interacts normally with the useless protagonist as well.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=727030]Getchu[/url]]
